author: TeIq
content:
ML classifier integration epic — SUBSTANTIAL CLOSURE.

## Landed (6 of 7 PRs)
- #124 Q-resolution
- #125 PR 1: proto schema + polaris-classifier-proto codegen crate
- #126 PR 2: ClassifierClient trait + tonic prod impl + fixture impl
- #127 PR 3: fan-out subscriber + Observation materialization + wellness hook
- #128 PR 4: circuit breaker + per-classifier concurrency budget
- #130 PR 6: opt-in feedback + AC-7 privacy boundary tests
- #131 PR 7: polaris-sample-classifier binary + ops docs

## Deferred (1 of 7)
- #129 PR 5: disagreement UI (frontend-only — minimal visual delta on
  top of #97 NetworkPanel work that already renders multiple
  observations per case)

## Production-readiness assessment
The backend half is complete and operationally usable:
- Wire protocol shipped + codegen-stable + privacy-boundary verified
- Trait abstraction lets tests run without a live classifier
- Fan-out worker materializes ClassifierSignal observations with per-
  classifier JoinSet isolation
- Circuit breaker (10 consecutive failures / 60s cooldown / probe
  semantics) + per-classifier concurrency budget (64 permits default)
  match the design ACs
- Opt-in feedback path with AC-7-verified privacy enforcement at the
  build_feedback() function signature
- Sample classifier + operator docs for end-to-end validation

The disagreement UI (#129) is the only piece of the design's
acceptance criteria not satisfied; case-view rendering of multiple
classifier observations works via #97 NetworkPanel today, but the
explicit "this case was scored by classifiers A and B with disagreeing
labels" affordance is a future frontend PR.

All commits clean: 28 classifier-module tests + 5 sample-classifier
tests + main on stable Rust + clippy --tests -- -D warnings clean.
